summary:
Reviewed w124's commits 5e21bac, c8c7e34 and 63bdb23, which match the implementer's result. No Critical finding and nothing to fix now.
The only change under features/ is the retired r24 scenario the work-item lists under Retires. No test was removed or weakened, and no allowance was claimed.
ruff and vulture are clean; size printed nothing. The 4 hook scenarios pass.
Observations, reproduced in scratch repositories:
(1) Important: when the ledger commit fails (no git identity), the PreCompact hook appends nothing and tells the session nothing, so r33 and r34 go unmet.
(2) Important: a non-UTF-8 initiative.md crashes `migrate status --hook` with exit 1, against its exit-0 contract.
(3) Minor: the PreCompact hook would also commit to worker branches under work run.
Cannot verify: whether Claude Code gives PreCompact stdout to the model, which r34 relies on.
